verdict.rationale: Grafana has a public pricing page that lists a free tier ('No charges ever') and states that all Grafana Cloud services come with usage limits, so some self-serve pricing is published without contacting sales. The evidence never shows actual per-signal rates for metrics, logs or traces, so an SRE cannot be shown to predict costs from it. The community comment that Grafana Cloud is cheap does not establish pricing transparency. Missing for 10: published per-signal unit prices (metrics series, log GB, trace GB), overage and paid-tier rates, a cost calculator or estimation guidance, independent confirmation that costs are predictable without sales.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can predict costs from transparent published per-signal pricing without talking to sales

citations.quote: Perfect for personal projects, exploring new ideas, and early-stage startups. No charges ever.
All Grafana Cloud services, with usage limits
